create_transform_subclass: create a subclass of BaseTransform that overrides the transform method to modify a result dict
implement_transform_pipeline: implement a transform pipeline by chaining multiple BaseTransform subclasses together
call_transform_on_results: call a BaseTransform subclass instance on a results dict to apply the transformation
review_BaseTransform: review the BaseTransform abstract base class and its transform method signature
refactor_transform_method: refactor a BaseTransform subclass transform method to add new keys to the result dict
